subject: history_social
passage: Public swimming pools give city residents a place to cool off, so their use may rise when temperatures climb. Officials in Madrid, Spain, recorded the number of visitors to one outdoor pool on each day of a week in July 2024, along with each day's highest temperature. The figures suggest that pool attendance followed the heat: ______

data.title: Visitors to a Madrid Outdoor Pool during One Week in July 2024

stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to complete the statement?

choices.A: the two hottest days, Wednesday and Thursday, also drew the most visitors, 1,180 and 1,310.
choices.B: the pool stayed open for more hours on Thursday than on any other day of the week.
choices.C: attendance was lowest on Monday, when the high was 31°C, and highest on Tuesday, when it was 33°C.
choices.D: the high temperature rose from 31°C on Monday to 33°C on Tuesday.

explanation.why: The statement says attendance followed the heat, so the choice must link the temperature column to the visitor column. The hottest days, Wednesday (38°C) and Thursday (40°C), had the largest visitor counts, 1,180 and 1,310.
explanation.A: Correct. The highest temperatures and the highest visitor counts fall on the same two days, which is exactly what "followed the heat" means.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The table gives no information about opening hours.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Monday was indeed the lowest day, but the highest attendance was on Thursday (1,310), not Tuesday (720).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is accurate, but it mentions temperatures only, without the visitor numbers that the statement is about.
